fuel.quote: announce the Prix Maxima Affichés à la Pompe (PMAP) effective Monday, 05 October 2026. Both list the same three fuel types and prices: Super Carburant (SP95) at 5,300 Ariary per liter, Pétrole Lampant (PL) at 3,910 Ar/L, and Gasoil (GO) at 4,860 Ar/L.
